title: Lis Page - Verify export functionality on Column Configuration
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page

steps.action: Click on the export button from the list page
steps.expectedResult: Export all active column configuration in CSV format and the file naming convention should be "FMS_ColumnConfiguration_<yyyyMMdd>_<HHmmss>.csv"
